Anthropic has officially filed its S-1 to go public on the Nasdaq, marking a key structural transition for AI model providers.

As frontier labs shift from pure research models toward dedicated desktop environments and public markets, here are the top technical updates from the last 24 hours:

📈 Anthropic filed its S-1 registration statement for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq, with research firm SemiAnalysis breaking down the financial metrics behind the filing.

💻 Anthropic updated its Claude desktop application by introducing a dedicated Code tab. Users can now run six Claude sessions simultaneously, utilize mods, and access Claude Design without writing code.

📄 Google expanded Gemini with a full-screen workspace editor. The new tool allows users to generate, preview, and edit PDFs, Docs, presentations, and spreadsheets directly inside the Gemini interface.

📜 OpenAI released an updated Model Spec that defines five core values to govern model behavior, focusing on sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

📝 Google outlined a new four-step workflow in Gemini designed to take raw notes and format them into ATS-friendly resume bullet points.

As model interfaces evolve from simple chat prompts into multi-session workspaces and native document editors, which of these features will impact your daily workflow the most?
